limits: Synthetic routing fixtures do not establish general VLM quality or forensic detector accuracy.
No independent physical-phone accuracy, memory, thermal or speed validation was performed.
Release detector has desktop validation only; strict validated forensic distribution is not established.
Video uses up to four sampled visual frames; audio attachments are detector evidence, not transcription.
PDF covers up to three pages; selectable text requires API35+; visual reading is not certified OCR.
Cancellation is verified during decoding; native initial loading and vision encoding may delay interruption.
Local release signing may use the configured debug-key fallback; this is a local test build.
